SPEED_MULTIPLIER_DESCRIPTION: Target game speed. With Progressive Acceleration off, this applies all the time. With it on, this is the maximum speed reached during long automatic sequences.
PROGRESSIVE_TOGGLE_DESCRIPTION: Starts at 1x while waiting for input, then accelerates only while actions, animations, and automatic effects keep resolving. Card selection does not count toward the timer.
TIME_THRESHOLD_DESCRIPTION: How long continuous non-interactive action must run before progressive acceleration begins. Lower values speed up sooner; higher values keep short actions closer to normal speed.
TRANSITION_DURATION_DESCRIPTION: How long the ramp from 1x to the selected Speed Multiplier takes after the threshold. Lower values feel snappier; higher values feel smoother.
